researchBots.method: Pattern extraction from scientific + patent + OSS data

products.name: Autonomous Provisioning Mesh (APM)
products.description: Self-assembling infrastructure mesh that provisions compute, storage, and networking from idle resources across any connected devices. Zero-config. Peer-to-peer resource sharing. Pay-per-use crypto settlement.
scientificBasis: Byzantine fault tolerance in heterogeneous networks (arXiv, 2026)
products.deliverable: Yes — Node.js agent that runs on any device. Discovers peers. Shares idle CPU/RAM/storage. Built on libp2p + WebRTC.
products.profitable: Yes — take 5% of crypto microtransactions between peers. No upfront cost. Monetizes idle hardware.
products.whatWeHave: Node.js engine, Railway deploy, GitHub Actions, Stripe crypto, P2P libs available

products.name: Temporal Causality Engine (TCE)
products.description: AI system that ingests global scientific publications, patent filings, and technology adoption curves to PREDICT the NEXT 5 years of technological convergence. Not forecasting — CAUSAL INFERENCE on technology evolution. Answers: 'What will be possible in 3 years that nobody sees today?'
scientificBasis: Patent citation networks as innovation predictors (Research Policy, 2026)
Granger causality in technological convergence (MIT Sloan, 2025)
products.deliverable: Yes — API endpoint that returns top 10 predicted convergences with confidence scores and scientific basis.
products.surprise: PREDICTS the future from scientific causality, not from trend extrapolation. No other tool does this.
products.whatWeHave: arXiv API, patent DBs, LLM for text mining, causal inference libs
